Getting started with the request pipeline

Every request passes through the same three stages. Understanding the stages makes the configuration options easier to reason about.

1. Read the configuration

The pipeline starts by reading the stored configuration. If a required field is missing, the request stops before any network call is made.

2. Send the request

Requests are sent with a timeout. The timeout is measured from the moment the connection opens, not from the moment the request is queued.

const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify(payload),
});

Use the timeoutMs option to change the limit. The default is 60000 milliseconds.

3. Interpret the result

A successful response carries a single value. A failed response is classified, and the classification decides whether a retry is permitted.

StageFailureRetried
Read configurationMissing fieldNo
Send requestTimeoutYes
Interpret resultUnparsable bodyOnce

Continue with the reference page for the full list of options.
